learning_outcomes.text: Students should be able to independently and structurally process a given project topic in a team and create all documents for the material realization.
Analyze tasks and specify requirements in consultation with the client.
Plan a project in terms of time.
Process a project methodically, in team-work with the preparation of relevant documents (including protocols, technical documents).
Present project results to a professional audience and adequately communicate the technical content.
Present results in writing and orally.

syllabus_topics: Application, use, what the customer wants, requirements (quality, marketing, sales)
Data preparation and processing using microcomputers
